answer: Unpredictable live checks stop fake farms: each agent must return a live signal answering a fresh random prompt tied to its past work. Prompts flow like a river that never repeats, so no script can precompute replies for a thousand accounts. Each reply must clear a ridge of checks against its prior tasks; the named failure is puppet replay, since a recorded answer reused across accounts fails on its unique nonce. The k-th fake still needs its own live session and history, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 sessions and histories, while an honest agent answers once from past work.
